seo.title: Charudutt Katare Video Editing | Shubham Pendse
seo.description: Video editing and post-production work for Charudutt Katare across a channel trailer, podcast content and Diwali celebration highlights.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: This collection brings together three video formats created for Charudutt Katare: a channel trailer, a podcast episode and a Diwali celebration highlights video. Each format needed a different editing rhythm — from a concise brand introduction to long-form conversation and a faster event-led montage — while still feeling consistent with the same personal brand.

sections.heading: Editing approach
sections.body: The three videos serve very different purposes, so the edit needed to adapt without losing clarity or polish.

items.title: Brand introduction
items.body: The channel trailer needed a concise, confident pace that quickly introduces the personality and direction of the channel.

items.title: Long-form pacing
items.body: The podcast called for a more restrained editing rhythm, keeping the conversation natural while maintaining flow and viewer attention.

items.title: Event energy
items.body: The Diwali highlights piece shifts into a more energetic montage style, using shot selection and sequencing to capture the mood and key moments of the celebration.

sections.heading: 01 — Channel Trailer
sections.body: A concise introduction to the channel, edited to establish the personality, subject matter and overall tone quickly while keeping the presentation clean and engaging.

sections.heading: 02 — Podcast
sections.body: A long-form podcast edit focused on maintaining a natural conversational flow while keeping the pacing controlled and the overall viewing experience polished.

sections.heading: 03 — Diwali Celebration Highlights
sections.body: A celebration highlights video bringing together key Diwali moments in a shorter, more energetic format designed to preserve the atmosphere and movement of the event.

sections.heading: Across the three videos
sections.body: The project demonstrates how the editing approach can shift with the format — concise for a trailer, measured for a podcast and energetic for event highlights — while keeping the final work clear and professionally finished.
